exposure: Participation in the Best Fed Beginnings initiative (a national quality improvement program involving multidisciplinary teams, learning sessions, and a Web-based platform to implement the Ten Steps to Successful Breastfeeding)
outcome: Process indicators aligned with the Ten Steps to Successful Breastfeeding
cohort: 90 hospitals across the United States participated in a national quality improvement initiative to increase breastfeeding and achieve Baby-Friendly designation.
finding: The Best Fed Beginnings initiative significantly increased the number of Baby-Friendly designated hospitals in the United States and achieved a significant increase in exclusive breastfeeding rates among participating hospitals.
followup_time: Data on Baby-Friendly designation was collected through April 2016, approximately 20 months after the intervention period concluded in August 2014.
